statement: Linux hid-playstation maps the common DualSense report to gamepad evdev axes/buttons, a separate motion/IMU device and touchpad input endpoints; a successful PlayStation driver bind alone does not prove SDL sensor association.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, HHD adbd50f, virtualgamepad archive a5310c6; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 1448-1555 and separate input-device setup. Real consumer behavior still needs exact-device lab.
